description: MCP frames, file contents (hello.txt, 128 KiB 'large', escaped, cache fixtures) and concurrency gates are embedded in the compiled test source. Temporary directories and, for runtime-cache tests, git repositories created with /usr/bin/git are generated independently in each run.
